title: E-commerce Settings
summary: Settings page with left vertical tab navigation (Payments, Checkout, Shipping, Locations, Notifications) and main content area showing a 'Getting Started' profile form. Sections include store name/email fields with an info alert, billing information with address fields, time zone and units of measurement selects, store currency, and order ID format configuration. Save button at bottom right.

layout.columns: Left vertical tab navigation (~20%), main settings form area (~80%)
